feeds.title: BC Alliance for Arts + Culture Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog for the latest news on BC's arts, culture and heritage sector. The BC Alliance for Arts + Culture is a nonprofit provincial organization that works to advocate, inform, connect and serve BC's Creative Community. Our members include organizations, professional associations, not-for-profit groups, artists, and cultural workers.

feeds.title: The Art Spread Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Art Spread's Blogging community, where we talk about all things art. This Blog creates a supportive community through artistic writing and literature, where we share short stories, poems, advice and so much more. The Art Spread provides a path for artists with adversity to success and financial stability. We strive to make art accessible to promote wellness through art.

feeds.title: Sandra Yuen Blog
feeds.description: Blog, book reviews, events and updates from Sandra Yuen aka Sandra Yuen MacKay. For Sandra, art began as a healing tool from illness but grew into a passion and a career. She wants to spread hope and optimism through these pieces, drawing from the depths of suffering transformed into a new entity, a rebirth.

feeds.title: Jennifer Tazewell Mawby Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated about Jennifer Tazewell Mawby's latest news by keeping up with her blog. Jennifer Tazewell Mawby works with invented narrative cycles and across drawing and painting, sculptural and video/sound installation. Her work has been included in recent publications such as Art Maze and the inaugural issue of Art in Square magazines.

feeds.title: Booooooom Blog » Art
feeds.description: Here's the entire archive of art-related articles on Booooooom. Take some time to look around, and have fun getting lost in all the content. Booooooom was launched in 2008 by artist Jeff Hamada, with the hope that it would foster a community of people excited to go out and be creative.

feeds.title: Gillian McMillan Blog
feeds.description: Visit Gillian McMillan's blog to know about the art shows and view Gillian's work. Gillian McMillan combines a true love for birds, a fine eye for colour, hands which have learnt to mould clay, and a free-flying imagination ready to form a bird into a jug, or a jug into a bird. Either way, the combination of bird form and jug shape is without pretense.

feeds.title: Szymon Fugiel
feeds.description: I love art, and I love to write. This blog is my attempt to chronicle my life as I move towards being a full time professional artist. My name is Szymon Fugiel and I'm telling stories about the culture through art.

feeds.title: Pendulum Magazine » Art
feeds.description: Discover renowned and upcoming artists from around the world like illustrators, ceramic artist, painters and even furniture designers. We go beyond their artistic creations to discover their personal story. Pendulum Magazine is a place where we pause and take a moment from our busy, cluttered lives to appreciate all the creativity, talent, beauty, that is in the world.

feeds.title: Angela Gooliaff Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts on visual art, illustration, writing and more. All on Angela's blog! Angela Gooliaff is an illustrator and author based in Vancouver, Canada. As a professional visual artist for over a decade, she was featured on CBC's North by Northwest for her colouring book murals.

feeds.title: Tana Lynn Blog
feeds.description: View contemporary art work by artist Tana Lynn in her blog. She is a diverse self taught artist exploring the intricacies of her emotions through encaustic and acrylic mediums.

feeds.title: VMF Winter Arts Blog
feeds.description: Learn about our festival, artists, curators and more on our VMF Winter Arts blog. VMF Winter Arts is a free interactive celebration of AR, lights, & live entertainment in downtown Vancouver. VMF was formed in 2016 with a vision to transform the way art is experienced in Vancouver.

feeds.title: Justin G​edak​ Blog
feeds.description: Gothic art, dark fantasy and medieval fantasy art blog by digital artist Justin Gedak. His series of gothic fantasy digital portrait paintings are themed around the concept of individuals who have gone through times of trouble, and survived to be stronger for it.

feeds.title: Curated Tastes Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Arts and Culture through the Curated Tastes' blog. We are Metro Vancouver's first and only art mediation company. Through fun, engaging and interactive art events, classes and tours, we make contemporary art approachable and relatable while introducing you to the local Vancouver art scene.

feeds.title: The Sneaky Artist Blog
feeds.description: Sneaky Art blog of the things I saw and the places I was at. Words after sketches. My name is Nishant Jain, and I secretly draw art of my world. I am a former research engineer turned writer, artist, and podcaster.

feeds.title: Dana Mooney Art Blog
feeds.description: Check out Dana Mooney's art blog, follow along for a look into her collaborations, projects and events. Dana Mooney is an abstract artist and digital marketer. Her artwork ranges from fine art and custom murals to home decor and design, and brand collaborations.

feeds.title: m. a. tateishi
feeds.description: View my thoughts on art and creativity. I am m. a. tateishi, an artist, and my work has been in over 80 group and solo shows in the past 12 years.

feeds.title: Claudia Wiebe Blog
feeds.description: Check the Artist's Blog page for the latest news on new paintings, upcoming exhibitions, and other exciting details from Claudia Wiebe SoulArt. Claudia is a self-taught artist who intuitively creates abstract mixed-media art with acrylic paints. Her work is inspired by the ever-changing complexities of love and loss, and joy and grief.
